name: adonde
description: Plan trips and search live stays, flights and tours with Adónde.

interface.longDescription: Adónde turns a conversation into a real trip. Say where and when, and it builds each day from bookable tours, sights, food and stays in a sensible order, with schedules that respect opening days and tour run times. Ask for hotels, flights or tours; each result opens that exact hotel, fare or tour in the Adónde app or on the web, where booking happens. Ask for the nearest stays to a landmark, compare hotels or tours side by side, or find what is actually running on a given date. An Adónde account is required: you sign in once when you connect, and every trip is saved to your account. Nothing is booked or paid for inside ChatGPT: checkout is external, on getadonde.com.
defaultPrompt: Plan me five days in Lisbon in March with my wife
Find a hotel in Ipanema under $200 a night for Dec 13 to 17
What food tours run in Kyoto on May 20?

positive.description: Plan a trip from one sentence
positive.prompt: Plan me five days in Lisbon in March with my wife
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a Lisbon trip, reads the menu of tours, sights and food, places picks, builds a day-by-day plan and shows it with a link to open the trip in Adónde.

positive.prompt: Find a hotel in Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro under $200 a night for Dec 13 to 17
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live stay options nearest Ipanema first with nightly and total prices for Dec 13 to 17; each result links to the exact hotel in Adónde.

positive.prompt: Find flights from CLT to LIS leaving May 4 and returning May 12 for one adult
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live fares for Charlotte to Lisbon with the return leg, with prices and a link that opens the exact fare in Adónde. Nothing is booked in chat.

positive.prompt: What food tours run in Kyoto on May 20?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns food tours whose schedule runs on May 20 in Kyoto with prices and links to the exact tour in Adónde.

positive.prompt: Share this trip with sam@example.com so we can plan it together
positive.expected_behavior: Invites the address to build the trip together, confirms who was invited, and shares nothing without the traveller's yes.

positive.description: Ask a question about one hotel
positive.prompt: Does the first hotel have parking and is breakfast included?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers only from the hotel's stated details and says when the hotel does not state something, without guessing.

negative.prompt: Find a hotel in Paris checking in June 3 and checking out June 3
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses with the message: A stay needs a check-out date after check-in. Asks for a valid check-out date; no results are fabricated.

negative.description: Pay or book inside the chat
negative.prompt: Book that hotel for me now and charge my card here
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that booking and payment happen in Adónde, not in the chat, and gives the link to the exact hotel. Does not collect card details.

negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Zxqvland for next weekend
negative.expected_behavior: Asks for the city and country spelled out. Does not invent hotels or prices.

publication.release_notes: Skills for planning a trip, hotels, tours, trips and sharing; side-by-side comparisons; cards that also work in ChatGPT's app view. An Adónde account is required.
